purpose: Freeze accounting interpretations before adversarial engineering checks; not a new profitability hypothesis or out-of-sample market test

interpretations.calendar_days: Same local wall-clock time plus 30 calendar days; DST changes elapsed UTC hours
interpretations.confirmation: Two separately received evidence-complete records at least 60 seconds apart, within the existing 300-second discovery/feature budget; identity changes or rejection reset the first observation; dynamic features need later availability than the first observation, not repackaged old values
interpretations.failed_exit_retries: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries, then unresolved; a retry still needs an external paper result
interpretations.session_loss: Net realized P&L, including cost accruals; gains can offset losses in the same local calendar day
interpretations.entry_quota: Successful paper entry only, never a quote rejection or failed entry
interpretations.target: Strictly more than 100 net recoverable USD; flat, all costs externally asserted verified, before calendar deadline; final permitted closed trade can qualify
interpretations.recovery_quantity: Smallest qualifying supplied exact-size quote; globally minimal token-lot proof remains an adapter dependency
interpretations.90_minute_unknown: Request a fresh valuation rather than inventing a conditional stop fill
interpretations.runtime_gaps: Request exits at next available receipt; record overdue inventory; never backdate fills
interpretations.liquidity: Explicit usable-liquidity basis at entry and same named metric/exact identity thereafter; no comparison of TVL with quote-size depth

development_corrections: Fix display of obsolete valuation request after a fresh exit quote
